title: Graded
text: {who} has the Ledger's columns up on the Civilian Center's screen, and the colony's own report grades beside them. "It's a gradebook. Every sol we sent our grades up, and every sol somebody marked them. Eleven classes before us." Nobody laughs.

choices.label: "We'll stop sending them."
choices.reply: "And then what does it do?" {who} asks. Nobody knows. The report goes out at sol's end, as it always has.

choices.label: "Then we pass differently."
choices.reply: {who} looks at you for a long time. "I'd like to know what that means. I think you would too."

notes: A colonist at home reacts by name once the-ledger is done (the discovery played back at home, v0.90.0).
